steps.name: runtime-contract-foundation
steps.summary: API/worker runtime 공통 계약으로 env config, worker loop options, health/dispatch result, composition root Protocol, framework-neutral API request/response DTO와 import boundary 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: auth-api-session-runtime
steps.summary: MetaMask login challenge/session use case, framework-neutral auth API handler, injected PostgreSQL auth repositories/schema, structured auth error mapping과 fake 기반 runtime 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: order-api-checkout-start
steps.summary: 고객 주문 생성 application/API와 injected PostgreSQL order repositories/schema를 추가하고 OrderCreatedEvent outbox payload로 checkout 시작 계약을 검증했다.

steps.name: checkout-tracking-payment-api
steps.summary: Checkout tracking read model/query adapter와 framework-neutral tracking API를 추가하고, txHash 제출 API가 PaymentCommandHandler를 통해 SUBMITTED 상태로 전이하도록 검증했다.

steps.name: worker-runtime-orchestration
steps.summary: outbox relay, Kafka consumer, payment receipt polling, payment timeout scheduler를 주입형 bounded worker runtime으로 조립하고 worker entrypoint/fake 기반 orchestration 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: operator-observability-api
steps.summary: read-only operator observability API, policy protocol, PostgreSQL dashboard/detail query adapter를 추가해 order/payment/outbox/worker/error 상태와 retry candidate/page token 계약을 검증했다.

steps.name: api-worker-runtime-verification
steps.summary: API/worker runtime public contract 테스트를 추가해 API facades, worker/runtime exports, CLI JSON entrypoint, import boundary, env/compose/schema 일관성을 검증하고 README/app README의 runtime 명령과 UI/e2e 다음 phase 후보를 정리했다.
